# apple_in_app_purchase_review_screenshot (Resource)

Manages the App Store review screenshot of a in-app purchase: the image App Review is shown of the in-app purchase as a customer sees it before buying.

A in-app purchase holds at most one. Apple has no request that swaps the image, so a changed file is uploaded as a new screenshot after the old one is deleted — the `id` changes. The file is tracked by its MD5, computed at plan time: editing the image in place is a diff, and so is a screenshot replaced by hand in App Store Connect. When the in-app purchase already has a screenshot with the same content, it is adopted rather than uploaded again.

The file parts are sent to the presigned storage URLs Apple issues for the upload, over a separate HTTP client that never carries the App Store Connect API token.

Apple processes the image after upload. An image it rejects — wrong dimensions, an unsupported format — fails the apply with Apple's reason, and the rejected upload is removed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_apps" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}

resource "apple_in_app_purchase" "pro_unlock" {
  app_id               = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
  product_id           = "com.example.app.prounlock"
  name                 = "Pro Unlock"
  in_app_purchase_type = "NON_CONSUMABLE"
}

# What App Review is shown of the purchase: a screenshot of the screen that
# sells it. Editing the image uploads it again; moving or renaming the file does
# not.
resource "apple_in_app_purchase_review_screenshot" "pro_unlock" {
  in_app_purchase_id = apple_in_app_purchase.pro_unlock.id
  file               = "${path.module}/review/pro-unlock.png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file` (String) Path to the image on the machine running Terraform — a PNG or JPEG. Only its content matters: renaming or moving the file without changing it is not a change. Null after an import until the configuration supplies it.
- `in_app_purchase_id` (String) The ID of the `apple_in_app_purchase` the screenshot belongs to. Cannot be changed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique Apple-generated identifier for the screenshot. Changes whenever the file does.
- `source_file_checksum` (String) MD5 of the uploaded file, lower-case hex, as Apple records it. Computed from `file` at plan time. Empty when Apple failed to process the image, which makes the next plan replace it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The import ID is the in-app purchase ID: a purchase holds at most one review
# screenshot, and the screenshot's own ID changes whenever the file does.
terraform import apple_in_app_purchase_review_screenshot.pro_unlock 6745123891
```
